en.headline: Retiree living costs rise three times faster than city inflation
en.dek: A new Hong Kong-Macau index from financial planners and a trustee put average monthly spending at HK$15,090, with travel and cross-boundary trips a main driver.
body: The living costs of Hong Kong retirees have risen nearly three times as fast as the city's general inflation since late 2020, according to the first Hong Kong-Macau Retirement Expense Index released on Thursday by the Institute of Financial Planners of Hong Kong and YF Life Trustees.

The index stood at 131.6 in 2026, up from 127 in 2023 and a base of 100 in 2020. The sponsors said it grew by more than 5 per cent a year from November 2020 to May 2026, while Hong Kong's Composite Consumer Price Index rose by about 1.8 per cent a year over the same span. Average monthly spending by the retirees surveyed was put at about HK$15,090.

Institute chief executive Paris Yeung said travel and commuting between Hong Kong and the mainland had increased sharply after pandemic restrictions ended, lifting transport and accommodation bills. The study said about four in five respondents had visited Greater Bay Area cities on the mainland, spending about 1,100 yuan per trip on average. Travel recorded the largest rise among the items tracked, followed by food, dining and cross-boundary transport.

The release also covered Macau for the first time, putting average monthly retiree spending there at 10,408 patacas. The sponsors said general inflation figures can understate the cash retirees actually need, and that planning should be checked against a retirement-specific gauge rather than the headline consumer price index alone.

zh.headline: 退休開支指數升幅近通脹三倍 月均開支約1.5萬
zh.dek: 財務策劃師學會聯同萬通信託公布首個港澳退休開支指數，指平均每月開支約15,090元，旅遊及跨境行程是主要動力之一。
body: 香港財務策劃師學會聯同萬通信託周四公布首個「港澳退休開支指數」，顯示本地退休人士生活開支自2020年底以來的升幅，接近同期整體通脹的三倍。
指數由2020年基準100點，升至2023年的127點，2026年再升至131.6點。主辦方指，2020年11月至2026年5月年化升幅超過5%，同期香港綜合消費物價指數每年約升1.8%。受訪退休人士平均每月開支約15,090港元。
學會行政總裁楊碩說，疫情限制解除後，退休人士外遊及往返內地明顯增加，交通及住宿開支上升。調查指約八成受訪者曾到大灣區內地城市，每次平均消費約人民幣1,100元。各項目之中，旅遊升幅最大，其次是食物、外出用膳及跨境交通。
今年調查首次納入澳門，當地退休人士平均每月開支為10,408澳門元。主辦方表示，一般通脹數字未必完全反映退休現金流需要，規劃收入時應同時參考退休專屬開支指標，而非只看綜合消費物價指數。
